differences.aspect: hidden random source and repeated object calls
differences.native: LeetCode constructs Solution(radius, x_center, y_center); each randPoint() call obtains two hidden random() values.
differences.app: solve receives the same constructor values plus an authored random_values stream and draws count, defines a local random() source, and invokes the same randPoint calculation for each requested result.
differences.rationale: An offline deterministic judge must expose random inputs and a finite call count. For each point, both forms apply the identical square-root radial transform, angle transform, center translation, and constant-time arithmetic.
